results.title: Winter Sky
results.overview: On the first day of winter break, Ivy League student Sophia reluctantly joins her boyfriend James and his friends for coffee before their trip to his family's ski cabin. As the conversation progresses, Sophia feels disregarded to the point she never wants to see any of them ever again.

results.title: Mexico, Mexico, Souvenir
results.overview: A tourist arrives in Mexico City ready to consume it out of control. The protagonist's photographic delirium leads him to the most bizarre situations in his desire to get souvenirs.

results.title: Mothers, Lovers and Others
results.overview: This ensemble drama explores a number of interweaving relationships, all grappling with polyamory and sexual expression, amid the personal and societal expectations faced by each character.

results.title: For a Red Shirt
results.overview: By a remarkable coincidence, the invention of cinema coincides with the first major wave of Greek immigration to America. Inspired by this event, the film unravels the thread of immigration from that time to the great crisis of the 21st century, through its cinematic recordings with unknown or rare documents.

results.title: Oscar Wilde About America
results.overview: This big-hearted romp from New York City to Hollywood, CA leads Oscar to the queer joy, love, and liberation that eluded him 141 years ago, with the attendant themes of diversity, identity, and inclusion beautifully expressed in the film's original song, "Be Yourself, Everyone Else Is Taken", based on one of Wilde's most popular quotes. Filmed in London and in multiple locations across the United States, the film stars West End star Oscar Conlon-Morrey as Oscar Wilde, and features film/TV/stage veterans Rosemary Harris and Kate Burton.

results.title: MGA MAGICAL 10 YEARS DOCUMENTARY FILM 〜THE ORIGIN〜
results.original_title: MGA MAGICAL 10 YEARS DOCUMENTARY FILM 〜THE ORIGIN〜
results.overview: Mrs. GREEN APPLE, consisting of Motoki Ohmori (Vo/Gt), Hiloto Wakai (Gt), and Ryoka Fujisawa (Key), has now ascended to the status of national icons in Japan. As they celebrate their 10th anniversary since their major debut, 2025 marks a pivotal milestone in their career. During the two-day "MGA MAGICAL 10 YEARS ANNIVERSARY LIVE ~FJORD~" which drew an audience of 100,000, the band surprised the crowd with an unannounced performance of their new song, "Variety". The shockwaves that swept through the stadium still resonate deeply today.

results.title: Miss Pots
results.overview: A new teacher in class always takes some getting used to, but Miss Pots beats it all. Kaya and Simon can't get along with her so they decide not to rest until they have gotten rid of Pots...

results.title: RevPro Uprising 2025
results.overview: Uprising 2025 was a professional wrestling event produced by Revolution Pro Wrestling (RevPro) that took place on December 14, 2025, at the Vale Arena in Cardiff, Wales, UK, and was headlined by Sha Samuels (c) vs. Jay Joshua for the Undisputed British Heavyweight Championship.

results.title: Snowman
results.overview: The evil sorceress destroys Santa Claus' staff, and now the New Year is under threat, because Santa Claus disappears without his staff. Only the Snowman can save the holiday and fix everything.

results.title: Under the Sky Without My Mom
results.overview: Four sisters in a salt village grieve losing both parents. With dad in a nursing home, the eldest carries their grief alone. Can they hold their family together?

results.title: Vista Mare
results.overview: A picturesque village on the Italian coast  squeezed between the mountains, the sea  and the expensive over-tourism, like every  year is taken by storm by millions of tourists,  but this summer everything will not go as  planned…

results.title: Pound It?
results.overview: When a man seeks a casual hookup with a stranger, he unexpectedly confronts his own feelings of asexuality; leading to a conversation between the flings.

results.title: The Fix-It-Man and the Fix-It-Wooman
results.overview: On a big-city dance floor, two soft sculptures try to impress each other with their moves. But it takes a comical mishap to bring them together.

results.title: Give Me Flowers
results.overview: Three friends - Baaska, Sashok and Petka - gather in an old village club and learn that their childhood friend Vadim, who came from abroad, did not invite them to his wedding. Trying to cope with the bitterness of lost friendships, they immerse themselves in memories and fantasies about a better life.

results.title: Shallow
results.overview: A pair of teenage friends grapple with their pride and masculinity as they attempt to connect on an eventful night out.

results.title: Naima
results.overview: Naima, a 46-year-old Venezuelan, lives in precarious conditions in Basel and, after many years in the low-wage sector, she secures a traineeship in nursing. However, her happiness collides with a harsh reality: patients love her compassionate humour, but her colleagues perceive her as lacking professional distance. When she fails her internship, her world falls apart.
